summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market purchases under its existing buyback programme announced 20 May 2025. For 7-11 September 2026, the company bought 211,539 ordinary shares at volume-weighted average prices of EUR 22.44-22.94 and 109,704 ADS-underlying ordinary shares at USD 26.67-27.36. All shares will be cancelled, shrinking share count; a US equivalent would be an issuer tender/buyback disclosure on Form 8-K. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch weekly disclosure cadence, cancellation pace versus prior tranches, and residual programme authority as a signal on capital-return intensity.
